comment: The panel prints Thresh and Gain over each pair of knobs. No range is given for the two CV inputs because neither is clamped: the threshold input is added whole to the knob and the gain input is halved and added, and a large enough negative voltage drives either below zero. The threshold knob comes up fully clockwise and the gain knob at the centre (src/MentalFold.cpp:44-47). The fold is a single reflection, not a repeated one, so a signal far above the threshold comes out inverted rather than folded again.
